episodes.title: Heaven’s Half Hour
episodes.summary: Matt Murdock gives up the mask. Wilson Fisk has his sights set to new heights.

episodes.title: Optics
episodes.summary: Matt Murdock gets a new client who's more than he claims to be. Fisk learns the power of optics.

episodes.title: The Hollow of His Hand
episodes.summary: The trial of Hector Ayala begins. Fisk's old business associates seek to claim his vacant mantle.

episodes.title: Sic Semper Systema
episodes.summary: Matt Murdock and Wilson Fisk's darker halves fight to be unleashed.

episodes.title: With Interest
episodes.summary: A day in the life of Matt Murdock gets unexpectedly intense, forcing him to team up with a familiar face.

episodes.title: Excessive Force
episodes.summary: When a serial killer terrorizes the streets of New York, the city needs a savior.

episodes.title: Art for Art’s Sake
episodes.summary: Daredevil. Is. Back. It's a race to stop Muse before he can kill again. Fisk's rivals in the criminal underworld take advantage of the chaos.

episodes.title: Isle of Joy
episodes.summary: At his inaugural Black and White Ball, Mayor Fisk tightens his grip on New York City. Matt Murdock learns shocking information when an old enemy reaches out.

episodes.title: Straight to Hell
episodes.summary: Mayor Fisk becomes Mayor Kingpin, and Daredevil is unleashed as chaos takes over the city.

episodes.title: The Northern Star
episodes.summary: Daredevil is in hiding, but he isn't laying low. A shadowy player from Washington, D.C. emerges.

episodes.title: Shoot the Moon
episodes.summary: Fisk tries a new tactic to lure Daredevil out of hiding.

episodes.title: The Scales & the Sword
episodes.summary: Matt Murdock and Karen Page find new allies.

episodes.title: Gloves Off
episodes.summary: Bullseye adopts a new morning routine. Fisk takes the ring.

episodes.title: The Grand Design
episodes.summary: The Anti-Vigilante Task Force intensifies its search for Daredevil and Bullseye.

episodes.title: Requiem
episodes.summary: Fisk's operation is dealt an irrevocable blow. The resistance spills over into the streets.

episodes.title: The Hateful Darkness
episodes.summary: A trial close to Matt Murdock's heart grabs the city's attention.

episodes.title: The Southern Cross
episodes.summary: The city and its heroes enter an unprecedented era.
